findings.question: Border and visa systems: the body that operates it
findings.quote: No, Malta D-visas are only being processed by the Central Visa Unit within Identità
findings.value: Central Visa Unit within Identità (processes Malta D-visas)
findings.title: Visa - Frequently Asked Questions
findings.note: This narrower statement says the CVU processes national visas within Identità; no T1/T2 source found names the CVU as operator of a border system such as the EES.

review.reason: Malta FAQ states verbatim that D-visas are processed only by the Central Visa Unit within Identità.

findings.question: Civil registry core: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Records kept at the Public Registry include acts of birth, marriage, civil union, death, and adoption registrations
findings.value: Public Registry (records include acts of birth, marriage, civil union, death, and adoption registrations)
findings.title: Public Registry
findings.note: This gives custody to the Public Registry rather than its Civil Status Section, matching Civil Code art. 238(1), which the same page quotes.

review.reason: Identità page states verbatim that the Public Registry keeps acts of birth, marriage, civil union, death and adoption.
